newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Jardine Fleming in fund venture with Apex.
newsitem.headline: Jardine Fleming in fund venture with Apex.

text.p: Hong Kong's Jardine Fleming group has set up a fund management firm in Malaysia in a joint venture with a unit of Kuala Lumpur-based stockbrokers Apex Equity Holdings Bhd.
The new fund is to be known as Jardine Fleming Apex Unit Trusts Bhd, both companies said in a statement on Monday.
The statement did not say how much money the company would manage.
The Jardine Fleming group would have a 30 percent stake in the fund management company, while Apex would hold the balance.

Jardine Fleming currently has three joint venture operations in Malaysia, stockbrokers JF Apex Securities Sdn Bhd, futures traders JF Apex Futures Sdn Bhd, and investment advisers Pesaka Jardine Fleming Sdn Bhd.
